title: 第15章 再遇刺杀第16章 我妹夫
content_zh:
他交了灵石，导员将风灵剑和阵法材料交给了他，还附带了布阵的说明，这种简单的阵法，不需要专门的阵师也能布置。
韩风收起宝贝，出了珍宝阁，直奔灵兽峰而去。
他打算好了，现在先带小狐狸去登记一下身份，让小狐狸成为他的私有财产，保护它的安全后，明天再让小狐狸去把剑送给姜酥柔。
毕竟，这把剑现在是下品灵宝，而且谁拿到都能用，若是送给姜酥柔，换成中品灵宝，而且还只有他能用，这样一来，他就能够得到更好的武器，而且别人拿了也不能用。
岂不快哉？
韩风认识去灵兽峰的路，此时健步如飞，快速向着灵兽峰跑去。
唉，若是会御剑术该多好啊，直接飞过去，省时省力。
后半夜的时候，他来到了灵兽峰，上到了峰顶，找到了登记处。
修真者的世界大多数是没有晚上关门那一说的，此时的登记处也是灯火通明，各种照明用的法阵和夜明珠，把屋子里照的比白天还要亮。
“师兄，师弟前来为灵兽办理登记。”
韩风来到柜台前，一边说话，一边拿下背后的包袱，将小狐狸掏了出来。
那正在闭目打坐的弟子，睁开了眼睛，看了韩风一眼，而后淡然说道，
“哪个师兄那边养的灵兽？他怎么不来跟你一起登记交接？”
“不是养的，是捡来的，看它可怜，就收养了。”
“收养的？那也行，只要登记就符合规定，做过物种血脉检测吗？”
“没有。”
“嗯，灵兽的修为、物种说一下。”
“狐狸，没有修为。”
闻言，那弟子疑惑的看了看小狐狸，说道，
“没有修为的一只狐狸，那特么叫野兽，不叫灵兽，你在拿我寻开心？”

“你才是野兽，呸呸呸！”
小狐狸呲牙咧嘴的扮着鬼脸，证明自己的厉害。
“哟，会说话，开智挺早啊，看着有点像通灵玉狐，应该就是了，给你登记了。”
那弟子点了点头，而后接着说道，
“主人姓名，身份，修为。”
“韩风，落霞峰杂役弟子，没有修为。”
“没有修为？嘿，野人配野兽啊。”
那弟子嗤笑了一声，他还没有见过这么奇怪的组合呢。
“好了，登记完成了，现在这一只通灵玉狐，就是你的了，至于你签订的是主仆契约还是生死契约，那我管不着，把这个带在它的脖子里，烙印你的灵魂印记，就只有你能打开了。”
那弟子拿出一个细长的小项圈，递给了韩风。
韩风拿着项圈，戴在了小狐狸的脖子上，让小狐狸不高兴嘟着嘴。
好在韩风没有跟它签订任何契约，它是完全自由且不受限制的，否则早就挠韩风了。
做完后，韩风便走了出去。
那个小项圈只是身份牌，没有别的束缚作用。
他出去后，那个弟子翘着二郎腿，拿出来一块传音玉简，悠悠说道，
“二哥，前两天抢了你道侣的那个韩风，那个杂役弟子，刚刚在我这边给它的灵兽登记了身份，正往山下走呢。
他黑巾蒙面，头戴斗笠，抱着一只通灵玉狐。
随便找个人弄死吧，别亲自干，为这种垃圾不值得脏了手，你可是咱们家天之骄子呢，别把屎弄手上。”
说完话，他收起了传音玉简，转而继续修炼。
content_en:
He handed over the spirit stone, and the instructor handed him the Wind Spirit Sword and the formation materials, along with instructions for setting up the formation. Such a simple formation could be set up without a specialized formation master.
Han Feng put away the treasure, left the Treasure Pavilion, and headed straight for the Spiritual Beast Peak.
He planned to take the little fox to register his identity first, make the little fox his private property, protect its safety, and then ask the little fox to give the sword to Jiang Surou tomorrow.
After all, this sword is now a low-grade spiritual treasure, and anyone who gets it can use it. If it is given to Jiang Surou, it is replaced by a medium-grade spiritual treasure, and only he can use it. In this way, he will be able to get a better weapon, and others will not be able to use it if they take it.
Isn’t it wonderful?
Han Feng knew the way to Spirit Beast Peak, and now he was running towards Spirit Beast Peak as fast as flying.
Alas, it would be great if I could master the art of sword control. I could just fly over there and save time and effort.
In the middle of the night, he came to Spirit Beast Peak, climbed to the top, and found the registration office.
In most worlds of cultivators, there is no such thing as closing the door at night. At this time, the registration office is also brightly lit, and various lighting arrays and night beads make the room brighter than during the day.
"Senior Brother, Junior Brother is here to register the spirit beast."
Han Feng came to the counter, and while talking, he took off the baggage behind his back and took out the little fox.
The disciple who was meditating with his eyes closed opened his eyes, glanced at Han Feng, and then said calmly,
"Which senior brother raises a spiritual beast? Why doesn't he come to register and hand over with you?"
"I didn't raise it, I picked it up. I thought it was pitiful, so I adopted it."
"Adopted? That's okay, as long as the registration complies with the regulations, have you done a species blood test?"
"No."
"Well, tell me about the spiritual beast's cultivation and species."
"Fox, you have no cultivation."
Hearing this, the disciple looked at the little fox doubtfully and said,
"A fox without cultivation is called a wild beast, not a spiritual beast. Are you making fun of me?"
"You are the beast, bah bah bah!"
The little fox bared his teeth and made a grimace, proving how powerful he was.
"Hey, you can talk, and you are wise early. You look a bit like a psychic jade fox, so that's it. I'll register it for you."
The disciple nodded, and then continued,
"Master's name, identity, and cultivation."
"Han Feng, a handyman disciple of Luoxia Peak, has no cultivation level."
"No cultivation? Hey, a savage is worthy of a beast."
The disciple sneered. He had never seen such a strange combination before.
"Okay, the registration is complete. Now this psychic jade fox is yours. As for whether you signed a master-servant contract or a life-and-death contract, I don't care. Put this around its neck and imprint your soul mark. Only you can open it."
The disciple took out a small, slender collar and handed it to Han Feng.
Han Feng took the collar and put it on the little fox's neck, making the little fox pouted in displeasure.
Fortunately, Han Feng did not sign any contract with it. It was completely free and unrestricted, otherwise Han Feng would have been tickled long ago.
After finishing, Han Feng walked out.
That small collar is just an identity tag and has no other binding effect.
After he went out, the disciple crossed his legs, took out a jade slip for sound transmission, and said leisurely,
"Second brother, Han Feng, the handyman disciple who robbed your Taoist companion two days ago, just registered the identity of his spirit beast with me and is heading down the mountain.
He was covered with a black scarf, wearing a bamboo hat, and was holding a psychic jade fox.
Just find someone to kill, but don't do it yourself. This kind of garbage is not worth getting your hands dirty. You are the proud son of our family, so don't get shit on your hands. "
After speaking, he put away the jade slips of sound transmission and continued to practice.
